messages.author: b34a1ab65a7cd217
messages.subject: Error: Inconsistent projections
parts:
Hi Chris,

I want to calculate the overlap between two individuals c and d:

      GUESSc <- ctmm.guess(c,interactive=FALSE)
      FITSVFc <- ctmm.fit(c,GUESSc)
     
      GUESSd <- ctmm.guess(d,interactive=FALSE)
      FITSVFd <- ctmm.fit(d,GUESSd)
     
      b <- overlap(list(c,d),list(FITSVFc, FITSVFd))

but I get the error: Error in overlap(list(c, d), list(FITSVFc, FITSVFd)) : Inconsistent projections.

which is strange because both telemetry objects come from move objects with the same projection: proj = CRS("+proj=longlat + ellps=WGS84")

Thanks in advance,
Danai

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Error: Inconsistent projections
parts:
Hi Danai,

ctmm analyses have to be performed in a projected coordinate system to get area in square meters and speed in meters per second. When you imported those move objects into ctmm, there should have been a warning that the data had to be projected. If you imported them separately, they would have gotten different automated projections. You can import them together or give them the same projection afterwards, such as

projection(c) <- median(list(c,d))
projection(d) <- median(list(c,d))

Best,
Chris
